world.label: Loop
world.summary: Sam can pull a lever that knocks over the first of 40 dominoes in a ring; each domino is knocked by the one before it, and the first is knocked again by the last.

limits: Only a set lever can be pulled.

processes.rationale: A domino is knocked each time the one before it has fallen.

sam.said: chose the allowed move it had done least recently

checks.label: the one acting is allowed to make this move
the thing named is the right kind of thing for this move
